reviewer: Codex native_map_adapter, independent of fill/synthesis/engine implementation
scope: Finite two-port enemy-free bell-ascent demand adapter, optional materialize heights default compatibility and PlainsSimulator runner selection. Does not review own Godot adapters or media comparator, and does not approve human fun or production admission.

checks.name: Raw physics provenance
checks.detail: Independently decompressed and verified all eight gzip/raw hashes, input SHA, exact IDs/counts, exit0, completion markers and absence of ERROR/leak logs; 59 actual Godot cases.

checks.name: Demand binding
checks.detail: Canonical effective spec SHA matches result and candidate.map_demand; requested rise100 maps to local exit y320 from entry420; real occupied bounds [-350,158,1600,510] explain rejection of original width900 and bounded widening to2000.

checks.name: No holdout selection leak
checks.detail: Existing BehaviorArchive selects a single candidate from clean/mild calibration before exactly one holdout; no retry or alternate holdout winner. One feasible behavior cell is reported without claiming broad diversity.

checks.name: Finite original quality gate
checks.detail: Recomputed purpose on25 holdout raw results: clean1/1,mild12/12,moderate11/12; unchanged existing regular gate returns awaiting_human_review. Original moderate failure remains. All12 finite counterfactual policies fail physically; not a proof that no cheaper human solution exists.

checks.name: Concrete witness
checks.detail: Candidate recorded_frames exactly match bound nominal raw result:77ticks,HP5,one actual shot,real lift_bell opened at frame22 and stable goal; no advanced ability grant.

checks.name: Original synthesis default regression
checks.detail: Loaded origin/main synthesis read-only and compared old materialize(case,result) against new default on all8 real motion probe results: outputs exactly equal. Explicit heights only selects requested landing height; no new physical simulator.

checks.name: Runner default and source scope
checks.detail: PlainsSimulator runner_script defaults to unchanged res://runner_plains.gd; explicit MapEngine override snapshots external runner and own adapter sources. Existing timeout, completion, output identity and error rejection remain.

checks.name: Unsupported directed relation guard
checks.detail: Initial independent review found reverse/extra relations ignored. Implementer added exact canonical forward entry→exit/main guard; independently checked accepted canonical spec and rejected reversed/additional reverse specs. Original59-case physics retains original frozen adapter bytes; guard repair adds rejection logic and does not relabel that run as new-source execution.

resolved_findings.description: Unsupported reverse or extra directed relationships were not rejected, which could falsely satisfy a demand.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current _spec_errors rejects anything except the explicitly supported entry→exit/main relation; canonical/reverse/additional-reverse checks pass.

limitations: Only a finite two-port bell_lift ascent with exact basic plains abilities is implemented; no generic multi-port demand synthesis.
Space bounds are known solids/hazard/bell envelopes, not universal full action clearance. General seams/transforms/entry-state transfer remain UNKNOWN in canonical output contracts.
Difficulty intent is not a calibrated human 1–10 score; perturbation robustness is technical evidence only.
Counterfactual clean repeats are deterministic repeated policies, not independent player or phase coverage.
Technical candidates remain awaiting human review with production_admitted=false; new placement requires concrete whole-map validation.
